description: One AI image from a text prompt (optionally from a reference image): sprites, flipbooks, emissive or UI textures, concept images. No PBR maps: use pbr-material for tileable materials. Asynchronous: returns a generation id; poll get_generation. Spends credits (refunded automatically on failure). Typical time: 60 s.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Same key = same generation, never charged twice. Default: derived from the parameters for 10 minutes; pass a new value to intentionally run the same prompt again.

max_credits.description: Highest price the user accepted (from quote_generation). The call fails with confirmation_required if missing.

save_to_library.description: Optional. When the generation succeeds, publish it in the public 3DTexel community library and add it to the user's library (free). Only if the user asked for it.

name: generate_texture
title: AI texture / image
